faqData.question: RSVP
faqData.answer: Please confirm your attendance by the date indicated on your invitation. We have reserved one seat especially for you.

faqData.question: Adult-Only Celebration
faqData.answer: We love children, but this event will be for adults only. Thank you for understanding.

faqData.question: Dress Code
faqData.answer: Wear what makes you feel good, keeping it formal and within our colors.

faqData.question: Gifts
faqData.answer: Your company is the greatest gift. Should you wish to bless us further, we would be grateful for cash gifts, which may also be shared digitally.

faqData.question: Venue & Schedule
faqData.answer: Our celebration will take place at On Due Hotel & Events Place. Parking is available, with staff ready to guide you.
